chunks: Abu 'Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn 'Abd al-Jabbar, from 'Ali ibn Hadid, from Jamil, from Zurarah, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام, concerning a man who forced a woman upon herself.
He said: “He is to be struck one blow with the sword, reaching from him whatever it reaches.”

key_terms.امْرَأَةً: a woman, the victim in this ruling
key_terms.غَصَبَ: he compelled or violated by force
key_terms.نَفْسَهَا: herself; her person or bodily self
key_terms.يُضْرَبُ: he is to be struck; the prescribed penal action

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Tahdhib al-Ahkam for a man who forces a woman sexually?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a man who sexually violates a woman by force. Imam Abi Ja'far عليه السلام states that the prescribed punishment is a single decisive blow with the sword, indicating the gravity of the offense in Islamic jurisprudence.
